description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' JSON serialization support using System.Text.Json. It includes tests for serializer behaviors, deep copying, and handling various JSON-related types within Orleans serialization system.

classes.name: JsonCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for Orleans' JSON serialization using System.Text.Json, covering deep copy, round-trip serialization, and handling of JsonNode types.

classes.name: JsonCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying JSON-related types within Orleans serialization system, ensuring independent copies of JsonNode types and JsonDocument/JsonElement.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures Orleans serializer builder to support custom JSON types based on a attribute predicate.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates sample MyJsonClass instances for testing.

methods.name: JsonSerializerDeepCopy
methods.description: Tests deep copy functionality for MyJsonClass via Orleans JSON serializer.

methods.name: JsonSerializerRoundTrip
methods.description: Verifies round-trip serialization and deserialization of MyJsonClass instances.

methods.name: CanSerializeJsonValue_AsJsonNode
methods.description: Tests serialization of JsonValue as JsonNode, including deserialization and comparison.

methods.name: CanSerializeAllJsonNodeTypes
methods.description: Ensures Orleans correctly serializes and deserializes various JsonNode subtypes like JsonObject, JsonArray, and JsonValue.

methods.name: CanSerializeJsonDocumentAndElement
methods.description: Tests serialization of JsonDocument and JsonElement types with Orleans serializer.
